caption:
The spotlight effect: why you think everyone is staring. 🔦

You spill coffee on your shirt and feel like the whole room noticed. In a Cornell study (Gilovich, 2000), people guessed 50% noticed their embarrassing shirt. Really? About 25%.

Everyone is busy with their own spotlight. So go do the thing.

Send this to someone who overthinks.

#psychology #spotlighteffect #overthinking #confidence #mindset
